summary: Photographic evidence of laboratory inquiries, demonstration teachings, field research, and student co-curricular activities.

items.title: Compound Microscope Cytology Station
items.caption: Grade 7 STE students examining stomatal density in Allium cepa leaf peels during the cell physiology unit.
items.context: Context: This laboratory session marked the transition from textbook diagrams to empirical microscopic observation, emphasizing eyepiece graticule calibration and proper cytological sketching.

items.title: National Science Month Innovation Showcase
items.caption: Student investigatory teams displaying low-cost water filtration prototypes during the campus Science Congress.
items.context: Context: Serving as lead event coordinator, Teacher Ramelito established peer review defense boards where learners defended hypotheses before an audience of visiting STEM mentors.

items.title: Ecological River Water Field Sampling
items.caption: Collecting water samples along the urban river basin to evaluate microbial and chemical turbidity indicators.
items.context: Context: Conducted under strict parental consent and barangay safety escort as part of the regional science fair investigatory study on Moringa bio-coagulants.

items.title: Benchmark Demonstration Teaching Session
items.caption: Facilitating 5E inquiry-driven lesson exemplar during the Division Science Learning Action Cell (LAC).
items.context: Context: Attended by 120 secondary science teachers across the division, modeling collaborative student grouping and real-time formative feedback rubrics.
